intro_en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own, so this list matters. These places are fictional, like the university.
intro_zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala, ngakho lolu hlu lubalulekile. Lezi zindawo ziqanjiwe, njengenyuvesi.
note_en: Not on the list? Don't pay anything. Ask the Housing Desk first.
note_zu: Ayikho ohlwini? Ungakhokhi lutho. Buza eDeskini Lezindawo Zokuhlala kuqala.
